items.headline: Demon June runs for 3 TDs as North Carolina routs East Tennessee State 35-3 for 2-0 start
items.description: — Demon June had three rushing touchdowns and Billy Edwards threw for two first-quarter scores as North Carolina routed East Tennessee State 35-3 on Saturday in its home opener.
